flows: Navigate to http://127.0.0.1:8001/login then log in with email {{global.account1_email}} and password {{secrets.user.account1_password}}.

Open the appointment booking page.
Book an appointment for the first patient in the patient list on 2027-11-14 at 10:00 and submit.
Open the appointment booking page again.
Book an appointment for the second patient in the patient list on 2027-11-14 at 10:00 and submit.
Get the page message after submitting the appointment booking for the second patient and save as {{what_happened}}.
Verify that the second booking was refused with a message that the 10:00 slot on 2027-11-14 is already taken.
